headlines.title: Florida DMV says it was hacked shortly after major driver’s license breach
headlines.description: Florida’s Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles said Friday that it’s investigating a data breach, making it the second organization that hosts Americans’ driver’s license information to be hacked this month.

headlines.title: Strikes shut down key Saudi pipeline as Iran-backed Houthis tighten grip on crucial shipping lane
headlines.description: Houthi rebels effectively completed a rapid push to take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coastline on Friday, tightening their grip on one of the world’s most important shipping routes and delivering a dramatic boost to their backers in Iran.

headlines.title: Lutnick says Trump’s $5,000 checks for Americans wouldn’t rely on taxpayer funds
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s promised $5,000 “dividend” for all U.S. adults would not be paid for with taxpayer dollars, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said.

headlines.title: Inflation ticked up in August, setting the stage for the Fed to hike interest rates
headlines.description: Inflation overall in August rose by 0.4% month over month to an annual rate of 3.4%, which was unchanged from July.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Strategic Money Moves to Maximize Your 401(K) Savings
headlines.description: Making informed decisions on your 401(K) can make the difference between an comfortable retirement and financial struggle, so financial expert Ted Jenkin stops by TODAY to give his best tips for maximizing savings. He breaks down catch-up contributions, explains the benefits of auto-escalation, what to do with your retirement account if you change jobs, and more.

headlines.title: Lutnick says promised $5,000 checks for Americans won't come from taxpayer dollars
headlines.description: In a wide-ranging interview, U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick spoke about the $5,000 checks Republicans are promising if they win the midterms, the Trump administration's trade war with Canada and rising energy costs. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports.

headlines.title: Regulators missed $21B in Mark Walter's insurance empire
headlines.description: A new federal investigation found that two insurers controlled by billionaire Mark Walter, owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers, put roughly $21 billion into businesses connected to him. NBC News' Gretchen Morgenson details the federal probe and how consumers can protect themselves.

headlines.title: September 2026 Freebies: School Supplies, McNuggets, More
headlines.description: From free back-to-school supplies to NFL food giveaways, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with a roundup of ways to cash in on freebies for the month of September. Promos include free access to Microsoft software, a Carl's Jr. burger when the Rams snag an interception, a free small bundt cake from Nothing Bundt Cake and more!

headlines.title: Diesel hits all-time high of $6 per gallon and just about everything will cost more
headlines.description: “We are endangering one of the strongest economic pillars that we have in this country,” said fourth-generation Iowa farmer Mark Mueller.

headlines.title: Jimmy Kimmel says show won’t air James Talarico interview on TV, citing FCC threats
headlines.description: The late-night host, who cited FCC threats, said his interview with the Texas Democratic Senate nominee would air instead on YouTube.

headlines.title: Oil prices soar to $108 for the first time since May as bond yields jump
headlines.description: The price of oil surged again, with Brent crude surpassing $107 per barrel for the first time since May as markets brace for a long U.S. war with Iran.
